title: Joshua Wong, Hong Kong Democracy Activist, Is Sentenced to 10 Years in Prison
summary: Mr. Wong, one of the most high-profile members of a movement that was quashed in 2020, was accused of conspiracy to collude with foreign forces, a national security offense.
